do: Use concrete, sourced facts (dose, duration, study size) with a link to the source
Say plainly what the evidence does NOT show

First-person or reader-journey framing is fine in advertorials; late product reveal
Use real purchase options and prices from the live PDP only
dont: Invent numbers, ratings, customer counts, testimonials, experts or urgency timers
Lead on 'lab-tested'/COA as the main advantage (house rule no-coa-competitive-advantage)
